version.changelog: Add cursor pagination, todo state and due-date updates, custom vocabulary, writable Topic session types, current Session fields, and current webhook contracts.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Hedy API helper for reading and managing meeting data, with explicit confirmations for writes, deletes, and webhooks.

dimensions.detail: The skill needs network access to Hedy and access to sensitive meeting content, which is proportionate to its purpose but privacy-sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup requires a Hedy API key in OpenClaw configuration and curl/jq; there are no bundled executable scripts, dependency installs, hooks, or hidden install behavior in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to Hedy API use, include API-key handling rules, require confirmation before POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, require double confirmation for deletes, and warn before webhook creation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can create persistent Hedy-side objects such as topics, contexts, vocabulary entries, todo changes, and webhooks, but these are documented and user-confirmed; no local persistence or privilege escalation is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the capabilities: it reads Hedy sessions, transcripts, highlights, todos, topics, contexts, vocabulary, and webhooks, and it documents the corresponding Hedy REST API operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust Hedy with the meeting data available to the API key. Be especially careful when creating webhooks: confirm the exact destination domain and events, because matching meeting-derived data may leave Hedy and continue being delivered until the webhook is deleted.
llm.findings:
[TM1] expected: The DELETE endpoint references are documented Hedy management operations, not shell parameter abuse; the artifact requires explicit confirmation and double confirmation for deletions.
[E1] expected: The curl POST/PATCH/PUT examples send data to the first-party Hedy API as part of the advertised integration. Webhook creation can send future meeting-derived data to a user-provided external HTTPS URL, but the artifact explicitly warns about this and requires destination host and event confirmation.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited text says never prompt users to paste the API key in chat; in context, the same safety section requires confirmation before writes and double confirmation before deletes, so it does not support autonomous high-impact action.
